youtube_description:
This is the full unedited video of the questioning of Luke Denmen that was broadcast on Venezuelan state TV and presented by President Nicolas Maduro himself. 

On Monday 5/4/2020, former US Army soldiers and current employees of a private military corporation (PMC) known as "Silvercorp USA"' Luke Denmen, 34, and Airan Berry, 41, were captured by members of the Venezuelan Navy when their boat experienced engine trouble and they were forced to land in Aragua, Venezuela. 

The two men were reportedly part of a 60 member force consisting of mercenaries, Venezuelan expats and military deserters that had planned to invade Venezuela and kidnap President Maduro and fly him to the US to stand trial, an operation that the group dubbed "Operation Gideon".

The United States government has denied any involvement in Operation Gideon.  US officials made contact with the coup plotters prior to their departure and tried to convince them not to go through with their plan. 

The PMC, "Silvercorp USA" is owned by Jordan Goudreau and the corporation is based in Melbourne, FL. https://www.silvercorpusa.com 

When asked by the media who financed the attempted coup , Mr. Goudreau refused to answer stating only that the identities of his clients are confidential.
